32829.meaning2: having explained; having illustrated; having illuminated

examples.text: maccherā ca pamādā ca, evaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati, puññaṃ ākaṅkhamānena, deyyaṃ hoti vijānatā'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca, api nu te, gahapati, kule dānaṃ dīyatī'ti? dīyati me, bhante, kule dānaṃ. tañ'ca kho lūkhaṃ kaṇājakaṃ biḷaṅgadutiyan'ti.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānaṃ.

ekaṃ ekakaṃ, dve dukā, tīṇi tikā, cattāri catukkā, pañca pañcakā, cha chakkā, satta sattakā, aṭṭha aṭṭhakā, nava navakā, dasa dasakā'ti, satam'pi mayaṃ, bho gotama, gaṇāpema, bhiyyo'pi gaṇāpema.

32847.meaning1: with halters made of fine cloth; (comm) with spreads made of fine cloth

sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ atthi hutaṃ atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko atthi mātā atthi pitā atthi sattā opapātikā
punakammāya ukkoṭeyyā'ti, akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ punakātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbaṃ'ti ukkoṭeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

32850.commentary: (SNa) akataṃ dukkaṭaṃ seyyo'ti dukkaṭaṃ akatam'eva seyyo. (DHPa) dukkaṭan'ti sāvajjaṃ apāyasaṃvattanikaṃ kammaṃ akatam'eva seyyo varaṃ uttamaṃ.

examples.text: akataṃ dukkaṭaṃ seyyo, pacchā tappati dukkaṭaṃ, katañ'ca sukataṃ seyyo, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati.
yassa kāyena vācāya, manasā n'atthi dukkaṭaṃ, saṃvutaṃ tīhi ṭhānehi, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
na jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ. yo paribhuñjeyya āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi tikoṭiparisuddhaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ, adiṭṭhaṃ assutaṃ aparisaṅkitan'ti.
ñattidutiyena kammena kuṭivatthuṃ na desāpetvā, āyāmato vā vitthārato vā antamaso kes'aggamattam'pi atikkāmetvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge payoge dukkaṭaṃ.

32852.meaning1: who has done bad deeds; who has done wrong

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pubbe dukkaṭakammakārino yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

32853.meaning1: who does bad deeds; behaving badly
32853.meaningLit: doing actions which are badly done

examples.text: no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca abhavissa dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkaṭakammakārī ca kena naṃ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṃ, bālo ayaṃ bhavaṃ asappuriso'ti?
attānañ'ce piyaṃ jaññā, na naṃ pāpena saṃyuje, na hi taṃ sulabhaṃ hoti, sukhaṃ dukkaṭakārinā.

32855.meaning1: believing (something) to be an offence of wrong conduct

32859.commentary: (SNa) akataṃ dukkaṭaṃ seyyo'ti dukkaṭaṃ akatam'eva seyyo. (DHPa) dukkaṭan'ti sāvajjaṃ apāyasaṃvattanikaṃ kammaṃ akatam'eva seyyo varaṃ uttamaṃ.

examples.text: akataṃ dukkataṃ seyyo, pacchā tapati dukkaṭaṃ, katañ'ca sukataṃ seyyo, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati.
assaddhassa, bhikkhave, saddhākathā dukkathā, dussīlassa sīlakathā dukkathā, appassutassa bāhusaccakathā dukkathā, maccharissa cāgakathā dukkathā, duppaññassa paññākathā dukkathā.

32862.meaning1: badly spoken; incorrectly said; wrongly pronounced

examples.text: paṇḍitapaṭirūpakānañ'hi santike kathetuṃ dukkhaṃ hoti, te pade pade akkhare akkhare dosam'eva vadanti. ek'antapaṇḍitā pana kathaṃ sutvā sukathitaṃ pasaṃsanti, dukkathite pāḷipada-attha-byañjanesu yaṃ yaṃ virujjhati, taṃ taṃ ujuṃ katvā denti.

32863.meaning1: difficult to do; hard to achieve

examples.text: duddadaṃ dadamānānaṃ, dukkaraṃ kamma kubbataṃ, asanto n'ānukubbanti, sataṃ dhammo duranvayo.
evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, dukkaraṃ, bho gotama, sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan'ti.

32864.meaning1: which is difficult to do; something hard to achieve

examples.text: dukkaraṃ vā'pi karonti, sekhā sīlasamāhitā, ṭhitattā anagāriy'upetassa, tuṭṭhi hoti sukh'āvahā'ti.
na kho pan'āhaṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya adhigacchāmi uttari manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ. siyā nu kho añño maggo bodhāyā'ti?

32865.meaning1: who does what is difficult to do; performing difficult feats

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko dukkarakārako chamānikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati.

32866.meaning1: what is called the practice of austerities; what is know as the practice of extreme asceticism
32866.meaningLit: called performance of what is difficult to do

32867.meaning1: practice of austerities; extreme asceticism; gruelling discipline
32867.meaningLit: performance of what is difficult to do

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya adhigacchāmi uttari manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ. siyā nu kho añño maggo bodhāyā'ti?
tāya'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya n'ājjhagamaṃ uttariṃ manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ.
niṭṭhitacīvaro bhagavā temās'accayena cārikaṃ pakkamissati. iṅgh'āvuso bhaddāli, etaṃ dosakaṃ sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, mā te pacchā dukkarataraṃ ahosī'ti.

32871.meaningLit: discourse on the question about difficult to do

examples.text: anekajātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissaṃ anibbisaṃ, gahakārakaṃ gavesanto, dukkhā jāti punappunaṃ.
yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
so dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
n'eva tasmiṃ samaye dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, na adukkham'asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti

32877.meaning1: discomfort; suffering; unease; unpleasantness; something unsatisfactory; trouble; a bummer; stress

examples.text: so idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ
sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti, yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ.
sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā, adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

32879.meaning2: agglomeration of dukkha; mass of discomfort or distress

32880.meaning1: heap of suffering; mass of difficulties; mountain of trouble

examples.text: app'eva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā'ti.
evam'etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti

32881.meaning1: wearing away of suffering; extinction of stress; termination of tension

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya, sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paññ'indriyaṃ
ettako ce'pi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.

32882.meaning1: leading to the destruction of suffering; leading to the extinction of stress
32882.commentary: (MNa) sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā'ti idhā'pi maggapaññā sammā hetunā nayena vaṭṭadukkhaṃ khepayamānā gacchatī'ti sammā dukkhakkhayagāminī nāma. vipassanā tadaṅgavasena vaṭṭadukkhañ'ca kilesadukkhañ'ca khepayamānā gacchatī'ti dukkhakkhayagāminī. dukkhakkhayagāminiyā vā maggapaññāya paṭilābhasaṃvattanato esā dukkhakkhayagāminī'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu paññavā hoti uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā. sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ ayaṃ pañcamī upanisā bhāvanāya.

32883.meaningLit: discourse on desire for the uncomfortable, etc.

32884.meaning1: in the sense of being painful

examples.text: rogato'ti-ādīsu ābādh'aṭṭhena rogato, antodos'aṭṭhena gaṇḍato, anupaviddh'aṭṭhena dukkhajanan'aṭṭhena ca sallato, dukkh'aṭṭhena aghato, rog'aṭṭhena ābādhato, asak'aṭṭhena parato, palujjan'aṭṭhena palokato, nissatt'aṭṭhena suññato, na att'aṭṭhena anattato.
tisso dukkhatā, dukkhadukkhatā, saṅkhāradukkhatā, vipariṇāmadukkhatā.

32887.meaning1: from suffering; from discomfort; from pain

examples.text: evaṃ kir'assa ahosi, saddhā tāva dhammaṃ sotu'kāmā gamissanti'y'eva, assaddhā'pi pana dhanalobhena gantvā dhammaṃ sutvā dukkhato muccissantī'ti.

32888.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of dukkha
32888.meaning1: as suffering; as pain; as discomfort

examples.text: yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkham'addakkhi sallato, ubhay'antarena n'āhosi, kena lokasmi kiṃ siyā.
tesaṃ sutvāna sappaññā, sacittaṃ paccaladdhā te, aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato.
tatra, bhante, y'āyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā dandh'ābhiññā, ayaṃ, bhante, paṭipadā ubhayen'eva hīnā akkhāyati dukkhattā ca dandhattā ca.

32891.meaning1: suffering inherent in pain; normal suffering

examples.text: tisso dukkhatā, dukkhadukkhatā, saṅkhāradukkhatā, vipariṇāmadukkhatā.

32892.meaning1: discomfort and distress; pain and stress; physical pain and mental suffering
32892.commentary: (MNa) dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāyā'ti kāyikadukkhassa ca cetasikadomanassassa cā'ti imesaṃ dvinnaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya, nirodhāyā'ti attho. ayañ'hi maggo bhāvito tissatther'ādīnaṃ viya dukkhassa, sakk'ādīnaṃ viya ca domanassassa atthaṅ'gamāya saṃvattati.

examples.text: ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā
vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti.

32893.meaning1: uncomfortable phenomenon; painful experience; state of suffering
32893.commentary: (DNa) dukkhadhammenā'ti vadhabandh'ādinā dukkhakāraṇena. (SNa) dukkhadhammānan'ti dukkhasambhavadhammānaṃ. pañcasu hi khandhesu sati chedana-vadha-bandhan'ādi-bhedaṃ dukkhaṃ sambhavati, tasmā te dukkhasambhavadhammattā dukkhadhammā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: ajātaṃ asamuppannaṃ, asokaṃ virajaṃ padaṃ, nirodho dukkhadhammānaṃ, saṅkhār'ūpasamo sukho'ti.

katamo ca, bhikkhave, soko? yo kho, bhikkhave, aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, soko

32894.meaning1: uncomfortable in nature; of unpleasant character
32894.commentary: (SNa) dukkhadhammānan'ti dukkhasambhavadhammānaṃ. pañcasu hi khandhesu sati chedana-vadha-bandhan'ādi-bhedaṃ dukkhaṃ sambhavati, tasmā te dukkhasambhavadhammattā dukkhadhammā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

32898.commentary: (ANa) navame jāti'pi dukkhā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttaṃ dukkhaṃ adhivahati āharatī'ti dukkh'ādhivahaṃ. dukkh'ādhivāhan'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, lok'uttarapādakajjhān'ādi ariyadhamm'ābhimukhaṃ dukkhena adhivāhīyati pesīyatī'ti dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ. idam'pi vaṭṭavasena uppannacittam'eva. tañ'hi vuttappakārā devamanussādisampattiyo dadamānampi jātiādīnaṃ adhivahanato dukkh'ādhivahaṃ, ariyadhammādhigamāya duppesanato dukkhādhivāhañca nāma hotī'ti.
